title: Oven Roasted British Chinese Leaf Scones Clotted Cream
description: A comforting British dish featuring Chinese leaf, with a crispy exterior and a soft interior, served with clotted cream and a hint of flambe, all while being keto-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped Chinese leaf, almond flour, coconut cream, eggs, melted butter, and salt, and mix well.
Turn the mixture out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Pat the mixture into a circle that is about 1 inch thick.
Cut out scones using a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the scones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the scones in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
While the scones are baking, heat the grand marnier in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Ignite the grand marnier and let it flambe for 30 seconds.
Serve the scones with clotted cream and a drizzle of the flambeed grand marnier.
Let the scones cool for a few minutes before serving.
